description: 雲林縣消防局燃氣熱水器承裝業及其技術士名冊 [gas networks and fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 雲林縣消防局. 提供承裝業名稱、營業場所地址、營業場所電話、負責人姓名、技術士姓名等相關資訊. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 雲林縣消防局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in xls, csv, xml, json. The portal shows 2023-05-08 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
